answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Every identity must lock a 1,000 USDC stake in the escrow contract and sign the registration transaction with a Sparrow Wallet public key before voting or grading. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1,000,000 USDC and forfeits the full sum when the audit matches one ferrous steel seed-plate serial across the clone set and marks the batch with a sable slashing tag. Honesty stays cheaper.
